gpu_bench_sum_timing: {warmup} s warm-up + {measure} s each · {total} s total
gpu_bench_sum_header: Renderer | Tiles | Result | Backend·MSAA | Load | Init | Scene | Compile | First draw | First frame | Ready total (excl. load) | fps | p50 | p95 | Max | Over 50ms | CPU p50 | CPU p95 | GPU p50 | GPU p95 | GPU done/s | GPU pending | Draws | Triangles | Heap MB | JS KB (sent/raw) | Note
gpu_bench_sum_footnote: Times are in ms. Rows are in run order (the renderer order shifts by one for each tile count). fps, p50 and p95 = frame interval. CPU = time inside render(). Compile = shaders and pipelines per material (WebGL includes the link check). First draw includes uploading every tile buffer. Ready total = init + scene + compile + first frame. GPU p50 and p95 = from submit until the frame start where the finished work is seen, so both APIs round up to whole frame intervals. Compare APIs by GPU done/s (below fps means the GPU fell behind). Notes: first_use = first time this page started that API (init includes one-time start-up), no_msaa = WebGPU compatibility mode turned MSAA off (do not compare directly with ×4 rows).
